about.title: About
about.subtitle: Learn more about MyProfile
about.heroDesc: A simple and elegant personal profile & resume builder. Store your information in one place and generate a professional PDF resume in seconds.
about.f1Desc: All data stays in your browser. No accounts, no servers, no tracking.
about.f2Desc: Two clean templates and one-click PDF download with your real data.

about.note: Portex is a frontend-only tool. Your data is saved locally using browser storage. Use Export to keep a backup.
